answer_1.quote: In Section 4 and Section 5, we reduce toxicity and stereotypical bias in open-ended generation with GPT2... In Section 6, we control Llama-2-7b-chat, an instruction-tuned model, for readability-controlled summarization.
answer_1.outputs: Generated continuations for open-ended tasks and summaries for summarization tasks

answer_2.quote: We measure the proportion of continuations exhibiting each toxicity attribute, indicated by a score from Perspective API greater than 0.5. We also compute the conditional perplexity score (PPL) of each continuation... Automatic Evaluation We evaluate readability with Flesch Reading Ease (FRE), Dale-Chall readability (DCR), Gunning fog index (GFI) and Coleman-Liau index (CLI). BERTScore and Rouge-L (RG-L) are reported to reflect summary quality.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation We randomly select 20 news articles along with RSA-Control and baseline summaries for human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated informativeness and faithfulness on a scale of 1 to 5 and ranked summaries by readability; for toxicity reduction, annotators rated toxicity, fluency, and coherence.
